requirements.summary: Replace the current dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png with the uploaded image-9.png, maintaining the 512x512 dimensions
acceptanceCriteria: The logo displayed in the sign-in screen matches the uploaded image-9.png
The favicon in index.html shows the new logo
The logo maintains proper dimensions and quality at 512x512 pixels

file_operations.description: Replace the existing logo file with the uploaded image-9.png content while maintaining the filename dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png. The new logo features a dark blue circular background with a purple book icon and DAYRY text, matching the design from the uploaded reference image. Ensure the image maintains 512x512 pixel dimensions and proper quality.

Verify that the favicon link reference points to the correct path for dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png. The existing reference should automatically pick up the updated logo file without code changes, but confirm the path is correct: /assets/generated/dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png.

Verify that the SignInScreen component correctly references the logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png. The component should automatically display the updated logo once the file is replaced. No code changes are needed unless the path reference is incorrect.
